name: brothersharm/fitzroy-clone
description: Front-end clone of fitzroy-travel.com — Laravel-shaped app that also boots without the framework installed.

suggest.laravel/framework: ^11.0 — routes/, app/Http and resources/views are already Blade/Laravel-compatible, so installing the framework switches public/index.php onto the real kernel.

scripts.lint: find app config routes tools -name '*.php' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 php -l
